news.title: BJP begins outreach push ahead of local polls
news.description: BJP on Saturday launched a two-day state executive meeting in Cuttack, adopting resolutions lauding the Narendra Modi-led Centre and the Mohan Charan Majhi government. The party also began drawing up a three-month organisational and political roadmap.
